correctness.rationale: The frozen topology and maps are mathematically supported; the repair narrows the novelty claim, not the formulas. All admissible dual faces without x form Z=E(U)*E(B), since no same-shore triple is allowed and all mixed triples there are connected. With q surviving spokes, the non-exceptional cone over the link attaches along D(U)*E(Q); the attachment map is null by contracting the map from the discrete D(U) inside connected E(U), or simply mapping the discrete points into connected Z when q=0. The missing-spoke pairs are bare intervals between vertices in the connected core. The joins and suspension give the claimed integral wedges. The original inclusion result follows in degree 3 from embedding the quotient of cycle lattices into the free coordinate quotient of top chain lattices; the circle bases track the individual missing-spoke loops in the reverse dual inclusions. Independently checking the repaired terminal proof: at b-1 the link in the core is the contractible star with center p_b and leaves U, and at b it is the discrete set U. The core acquires a-2 circles in the latter attachment and xp_b becomes an additional exceptional edge, giving exactly a-1 new circle classes. At both stages every 3-simplex is in Z, with no 4-simplices, so H3 is unchanged. The old exceptional-edge loops map bijectively to the previous basis; the new xp_b loop is filled by one triangle, and each extra x,u_0,u,x loop is filled by the two fan triangles and the triangle u_0,u,p_b in Z. These relations and the edge-coordinate basis give a split surjection with free kernel of rank a-1. Natural integral Alexander duality on the fixed ground set and free-homology universal coefficients reverse it to a split injection with primitive image, in degree N-4; the identity in the other degree is N-6. These apply for every a,b>=4 and do not assert the original complex's homotopy type.

value.rationale: The last-spoke phase is a natural boundary in this filtration: a connected graph becomes a biclique plus an isolated vertex, the old contractible link is replaced by a discrete attaching set, and a single fault adds a-1 integral classes instead of one. The explicit kernel basis and split injection determine the fate of existing homology classes, which endpoint Betti counts, analogy with matching deletions, or a formal q=0 substitution would not give. This is useful terminal persistence data with an explanation of the jump, even independently of the broader nonterminal claim.
